build.name: make liblmdb + the shipped mtest drivers
build.cmd: make -s liblmdb.a mtest mtest3 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; test -x ./mtest && test -f liblmdb.a && echo built

build.name: compile Techne's crash-recovery driver against liblmdb.a

runs.name: upstream mtest (random put/get/del + cursor scan)
runs.cmd: rm -rf testdb && mkdir testdb && ./mtest 2>&1 | tail -3 && echo MTEST_OK

runs.name: CRASH: a second process puts 500 more inside an open transaction and _exit()s without committing
reopen and count (the recovery property: the uncommitted 500 must be absent, the 1000 present)

notes: Oracle: after a writer dies mid-transaction the database opens at the last committed root (1000 entries), with no repair step. Upstream mtest also run.
